body.name: Ordinary \(Q[S]\) source family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\)
body.construction: For \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\), set \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}=\{Q[V\setminus B_i](\cdot;b):i\in[t],\ b\in\mathfrak X_{B_i}\}=\{P_b(V\setminus B_i):i\in[t],\ b\in\mathfrak X_{B_i}\}\). The collection \(\mathbf B\) is ordinary identifying exactly when the ordinary ID procedure identifies \(Q[S_0](\cdot;x_0)\) from this full finite source family.
